'''Lola Curich Starport''' was the main [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Lola Curich]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. It had the capability to serve over 2,000 [[Starship/Legends|ships]].<ref name="MTL" />

==Areas==
The starport could be divided into several main areas:

===Military sector===
This sector was relatively small compared to the other areas and could contain around 100 ships. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], five [[Santhe Blockade Buster]], twelve Imperial [[Peacekeeper (ship)|Peacekeepers]], sixty [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] [[T-40 Flitter]]s and thirty [[TIE/ln_space_superiority_starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]]s were stationed there, separated from the regular fleet. These vessels were reserved for patrol purposes.<ref name="MTL" />

Security was provided by [[Imperial Navy Trooper]]s, [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] and [[Liann military trooper]]s, supported by [[Weapon detector]]s, [[Metal detector]]s and [[Magnetic pulse wiper]]s.<ref name="MTL" />

===Passenger Terminal===
This was the most busy area of the spaceport, servicing over ten million beings over the year, with three quarters of the spaceport's business related to this branch. Almost all large passenger shipping lines had offices here. The terminal itself had not the capabilities to handle large [[Passenger liner/Legends|Passenger liners]], transit shuttles brought the passengers there from orbit. Average prices are around fifteen percent higher than anywhere else, but cheaper traveling possibilities were available as well.<ref name="MTL" />

Security was tight here as well, with security devices, guards and inspectors wearing plain clothes.<ref name="MTL" />

===Private Craft Terminal===
This area was reserved for luxurious pleasure craft registered on Lianna; access was only available with a validated [[Identichip/Legends|Identichip]]. While the terminal was hard to enter, security inside was relatively lax.<ref name="MTL" />

===Commercial Docks===
This area had docking capabilities for around 500 medium and light [[Freighter/Legends|Freighters]]. The docks were connected to the Port Trading Zone and the Starport Sector. Visitors had to register with the Portmaster's office before they could leave the starport.<ref name="MTL" />

===Portmaster's office===
This was a three-story building adjacent to the main control tower. Bureaucrats handled the day-to-day business of the docking bays, including landing fees, customs inspections, departure time, supplies and licensing.<ref name="MTL" />

===Starport Proper===
Located throughout the whole starport were shops, garages and market spaces for spacers and traders. The most important businesses were:

*'''[[Biblack's Overhaul]]'''<ref name="MTL" />
*'''[[Astromech Heaven]] - Your Astromech Superstore'''<ref name="MTL" />
*'''[[Fronde's Airspeeders]]'''<ref name="MTL" />
*'''[[Thorip Norr]]'''<ref name="MTL" />
*'''[[The Palace of Light]]'''<ref name="MTL" />
*'''[[Shoppingland]]'''<ref name="MTL" />
*'''[[Thant & Sons, Starshipwrights]]'''<ref name="MTL" />
